# biobb_flexserv

### Introduction
Biobb_flexserv is the Biobb module collection for biomolecular flexibility studies on protein 3D structures. Biobb (BioExcel building blocks) packages are Python building blocks that create new layer of compatibility and interoperability over popular bioinformatics tools.
The latest documentation of this package can be found in our readthedocs site:
[latest API documentation](http://biobb-flexserv.readthedocs.io/en/latest/).
